settings_updates_channel_alpha_cadence: Whenever the maintainer cuts one, often several times a week.
settings_updates_channel_alpha_promise: The default while Atlas is in alpha. Fresh builds cut straight from main, with little soak. Features can be unfinished and behavior can change between builds.
settings_updates_channel_alpha_risk: Expect rough edges and breaking changes
settings_updates_channel_alpha_switch_to: You get the newest build of any channel, so a settings or config change may not be readable by an older Atlas. Going back to Beta or Stable later waits for a newer build there, or you can reinstall it explicitly.
settings_updates_channel_beta_cadence: A new beta about every one to two weeks while a release is soaking.
settings_updates_channel_beta_promise: Feature-complete builds that are being soaked before they become Stable. Only fixes land between betas.
settings_updates_channel_beta_risk: Mostly works; a bug can slip through
settings_updates_channel_beta_switch_to: You get the newest beta or release candidate, and Stable as soon as it is newer. Going back to Stable later waits for a Stable newer than your build, or you can reinstall Stable explicitly.
settings_updates_channel_env_forced: The channel is forced to {#b}{channel}{/b} by {#code}ATLAS_UPDATE_CHANNEL{/code} in this environment. Unset it to choose here.
settings_updates_channel_offer_none: Nothing newer than what you run
settings_updates_channel_offline: Could not read what each channel offers right now. You can still pick a channel.
settings_updates_channel_older_body: {label} has {version}, which is older than what you run. Switching alone keeps your build and waits for something newer.
settings_updates_channel_stable_alpha_er: While Atlas is in alpha, Stable means soaked through alpha and beta, not finished.
settings_updates_channel_stable_cadence: When a soaked beta is promoted, usually every few weeks.
settings_updates_channel_stable_promise: Only builds that already ran as a beta, with nothing changed since but the version number.
settings_updates_channel_stable_switch_t: You move to the next Stable release that is newer than the version you run. Atlas never installs an older build by itself.
settings_updates_channel_stage_alpha_not: Atlas is in alpha. Every channel, including Stable, can have rough edges and breaking changes until the first release that meets the general availability criteria in the versioning policy.
settings_updates_channel_tooltip: Alpha builds are for trying what is coming and can break. Beta is closer to ready. Stable only gets releases that met the bar.
settings_updates_channel_train_alpha: Builds are promoted from alpha to beta to stable. You follow alpha, the first lane.
settings_updates_channel_train_beta: Builds are promoted from alpha to beta to stable. You follow beta, after alpha and before stable.
settings_updates_channel_train_stable: Builds are promoted from alpha to beta to stable. You follow stable, the last lane.
